docker_note: previous: --cpus 16 --memory 46g --shm-size 8g, no PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF (torch 2.0.1 rejects expandable_segments); 48g = TRAINUNIT cell limit; debug off as FILL (jbgs_nodebug rule inside b151_entry.py, B151_NODEBUG=1); working folder = the attempt folder

scene_rules.sparse: BASELINES cdgs_scenes.py build with the WIDEN0 campus model WD/mvs/full/sparse in place of the box model: cell poses / ids / names, training-view 2-D observations scaled 1024/1400, 741/1013, points inside the expanded cell with >= 2 cell-training observations, tracks restricted, ids 1..N
scene_rules.split: split_index.json = indices of the TU1 cell split into the name-sorted images.bin list; no center.npy
scene_rules.units: s = median camera-z of own observed points of the training views / TT 2.646066780584012 (cdgs_units.target_depths)
scene_rules.prior_depth: stage-0 export prior rule on the inputs_prior cell surface (all faces): camera-z, pixel centres +0.5, NaN no hit, training views only
scene_rules.options: FILL options without v2_reference (no official fit run)
scene_rules.per_attempt_scene: <attempt>/scene = copy of scenes/CDGS_<prior>/cell<k> + links images -> /ro_images, prior_depth -> /ro_prior (CDGS writes plydummy/, confidence_map/ into its scene)

differences_from_previous: campus SfM model (WD, 819 training images) instead of the box SfM models; the cell as region; s recomputed per cell; the 1.5 M densify stop of CDGS applies to the whole cell
